{"reason":"Broaden the demand-forecast branch to accept market-signal mismatches or any nonzero forecast bias, lowering the 0.1 threshold to 0.0. This fixes the eight shown rows (five mismatches and three biases of 0.065–0.081), reduces unknown=23, and covers 1.33M in listed claim amounts while leaving supplier-delay detection unchanged.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (abs (bias-amount expedite-event)) 0.0)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
